integrity: The sharp constant and extremizers follow from an exact weighted collision identity plus equality cases of phase alignment, AM-GM, and Cauchy-Schwarz. Computation is corroborative only.
scientific_limitations: Characteristic two is excluded because the antipodal pairing degenerates.
The theorem concerns the sharp L2-to-L4 endpoint only; no other extension exponents or stability theorem are claimed.
Finite replay covers odd prime fields through 101; the proof, not the replay, covers all finite fields of odd order.
Residual originality risk remains for differently indexed Kloosterman, conic, or additive-combinatorics literature.
title: Sharp fourth-moment extension on the finite-field multiplicative hyperbola
